compiled_state.description:
## Summary

Discovered while proving `abusive-pebbly-sakimonkey` (e339-9709-15fe-419a). Independent of
that ticket's FIT divergence: under `reconciler.rich_text_cutover = "cloud"` (this project's
setting, `rebar.toml:87`) the outbound comment differ decodes the two sides of its
body-equality key with DIFFERENT decoders, so a markdown comment WELL WITHIN the length limit
never matches its own landed body.

- **Local side** — `_diff_comments` computes `codec.normalize_outbound(...)`. In rich mode
  `AdfCodec.normalize_outbound` is a markdown round trip, which ESCAPES markdown-active
  characters and rewrites autolinks.
- **Jira side** — `_normalize_comment_body` calls `inbound_mapper.normalize_rich_text`
  (`inbound_fields.normalize_rich_text` -> `adf_to_text`), which does NOT escape.

## Runtime evidence

Driving the real `AdfCodec(rich=True)` and `_JiraInbound` on current main
(worktree `fix-sakimonkey-dedupkey`), with an in-limit markdown body:

```
local key : '# Head\n\nSome *bold* text and a [link](<http://x>) plus `code`.\n\n- a\n- b'
landed key: '# Head\n\nSome *bold* text and a [link](http://x) plus `code`.\n\n- a\n- b'
EQUAL?    : False
```

The same asymmetry escapes the truncation notice: the local key carries
`\[truncated by reconciler\]` where the landed body carries `[truncated by reconciler]`.

## Why it matters

Body equality is the SECONDARY dedup layer guarding a lost comment-id map write (the crash
window between `add_comment` and `record_comment_id`). With the cutover ON it is inert for
every markdown-formatted comment, not just over-length ones — a strictly wider blast radius
than the fit divergence. `irongrey-chubby-oxpecker`'s commit message names this symptom
("richly formatted comments never matched and were re-posted forever") but repaired the
PRIMARY id skip, not this decode asymmetry.

This is NOT fixed by `abusive-pebbly-sakimonkey`, which makes the two paths apply the identical
FIT. Verified: after that fix the in-limit markdown case still diverges, for this reason.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The differ's two comparison keys are produced by the same decode under every
      `rich_text_cutover` setting.
- [ ] A test drives an in-limit markdown comment through the differ with the cutover ON and
      asserts no duplicate mutation is emitted (RED on current code).
compiled_state.title: Cloud comment dedup key is markdown-escaped on one side only
